brief: Clear the bird nesting material packed into the upper ventilation grille and top up the oil level where the sight glass reads below the minimum mark at ambient [MG-021]. Where an ageing unit cannot be attended before an event, apply the loading restriction in MG-021 in preference to accepting the exposure [MG-023]. Record every de-rating applied, the reason, the value and the period, and restore the full rating only when the underlying condition has been corrected and verified [MG-021].
